svg.title: PB-HY-001 HYBRID paddle - compression mould
svg.text: SCALE 1:2 · BOTH HALVES ARE THIS PART
SCALE 1:2 · CLOSED MOULD, SANDWICH 0.3 / 10 / 0.3, M6 BOLT
SCALE 3:1 · EDGE OF THE CLOSED MOULD AT X–X
Release wax + PVA, or release film
Flat platens ≥ 18 mm + clamps, or press
MOULD HALF (1): PRINT TWICE – BOTH HALVES ARE THE SAME PART (output/mould/hybrid_mould_half.stl / .step); TURN ONE
OVER ONTO THE OTHER. POCKET 5.3 DEEP IN EACH HALF = CAVITY 10.6 = SKIN 0.3 + RIB SUPPORT 10 + SKIN 0.3 WHEN THE FLANGES MEET.
PRINT POCKET UP, BACK ON THE BED: ≥ 5 WALLS, ≥ 40 % INFILL, 6 TOP LAYERS + IRONING ON THE POCKET FLOOR. NEEDS A ≥ 440 mm BED;
OR MACHINE THE STEP FROM ALUMINIUM / HDPE. ABOUT 1.0 kg OF PLA AT 100 % INFILL.
PLA SOFTENS NEAR 55 °C: ROOM-TEMPERATURE-CURE EPOXY ONLY. FOR A WARM POST-CURE PRINT IN PETG, ASA OR PA-CF.
PREPARE: SAND THE POCKET FLOORS (P400 → P800), SEAL (EPOXY COAT OR PRIMER), WAX + PVA RELEASE, OR LINE WITH
RELEASE FILM. PRESS THE 4 DOWEL PINS (3) INTO ONE HALF.
LAY UP IN THE BOTTOM HALF: SKIN (CUT TO THE PROFILE, 0.5 UNDERSIZE), WET OUT → RIB SUPPORT (FACES ABRADED, M3 INSERT
FITTED, SCREW IN IT) → TOP SKIN, WET OUT → TOP HALF OVER THE DOWELS. THE POCKET LOCATES THE RIB SUPPORT (+0.2).
CLOSE: BOLTS (2) FINGER-TIGHT, THEN PRESS THE MOULD BETWEEN 2 FLAT, STIFF PLATENS (≥ 18 mm PLY OR ALUMINIUM, CLAMPS
EVERY ~100 mm), IN A PRESS OR IN A VACUUM BAG UNTIL THE FLANGES MEET; THEN TIGHTEN THE BOLTS. BOLTS ALONE BOW
A PRINTED MOULD AND CANNOT PRESS THE MIDDLE OF THE BLADE.
EXCESS RESIN FILLS THE OVERFLOW GROOVE (2 × 1 IN EACH HALF) AND LEAVES BY THE 6 VENTS. CURE, SPLIT AT THE
PRY NOTCHES, TRIM THE FLASH AT THE EDGE.
MEASURE THE RIB SUPPORT (10 ±0.1) BEFORE MOULDING; SAND THE LANDS IF THICK. SHIM THE FLANGE (TAPE / FOIL) TO OPEN THE
CAVITY, E.G. FOR PRE-CURED SKINS AND GLUE LINES.
TWO-HALF COMPRESSION MOULD · CAVITY 10.6 mm · 234.4 × 429.4 × 15.3 mm PER HALF
